title: Anthropic Sets IPO Price Above Projected Range
excerpt: Anthropic has reportedly priced its initial public offering at $83 per share, surpassing its previous projected range.
body_html:
Artificial intelligence company Anthropic has reportedly set its initial public offering price at $83 per share, which comes in above the previously projected range.

Based on this share price, the long-awaited public offering places the company's valuation at approximately $1.5 trillion on a fully diluted basis.
